summary: Select with a menu that unfolds downward, a pixel highlight that springs between options and type-ahead by first letter.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices: `{ value?: string; label: string; description?: string }`. `value` defaults to `label`; `description` is a second line in the menu.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected value when uncontrolled. A form reset restores it.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the menu. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the trigger; also names the listbox.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the trigger; it also describes the trigger through `aria-describedby`.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the selected value submits under it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the select, disables the trigger and keeps the menu closed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user picks a different option.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

keyboard.action: Move the highlight; stops at the first and last option.
Choose the highlighted option and close.
Close and return focus to the trigger.
Close and move focus on from the trigger to the next / previous element.
Highlight the next option whose label starts with that character.

accessibility: The trigger is a native button with `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` pointing at the listbox, `aria-labelledby` pointing at the label and the selected value, and `aria-describedby` pointing at the hint.
The menu is a `role="listbox"` labelled by the label, with `aria-activedescendant` on the highlighted option; options have `role="option"` and `aria-selected`.
Opening moves focus to the listbox; choosing or Escape return it to the trigger. A pointer press outside, or focus moving to another element, closes the menu without moving focus.
motion: With reduced motion the menu opens without unfolding, the chevron does not rotate, the highlight jumps and the value swaps without rolling.
form: With `name`, a hidden input submits the selected option's value. There is no validation. Form reset restores `defaultValue` (or the first option) and calls `onValueChange` when that changes the value.
notes: The menu opens 6 px below the trigger and overlays the hint and the content after it (`z-index: 30`).
